# GLightbox 3.3.1

[GLightbox](https://github.com/biati-digital/glightbox) by Biati Digital, MIT
licensed (see LICENSE). Vendored here instead of loaded from a CDN, so the site
has no third-party requests. Used on the game subsite landing pages.

To update, replace both files from the release:

```bash
curl -L -o vendor/glightbox/glightbox.min.js https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/glightbox/dist/js/glightbox.min.js
curl -L -o vendor/glightbox/glightbox.min.css https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/glightbox/dist/css/glightbox.min.css
```
